snippet.title: Obey Me! Official Television Commercial — Lucifer
snippet.description:
An official television commercial for Obey Me! — a popular otome game with over 3 million downloads across 166 countries.
Enjoy an exclusive recording of Lucifer you will only hear here!

About our White Day Promotion — 
Promotion period: March 7, 7:00 (PST) - April 8, 8:00 (PDT)
*This period is subject to change.
